description: Diagnose a bridge/cross-chain transfer by source tx hash: checks LI.FI, Across (needs fromChainId), Relay, deBridge DLN and THORChain in parallel, plus the origin receipt, and returns status (done/pending/failed/refunded/not_found), destination tx and what to do next. Then offer the user a SwapChan swap (get_quote / the swapUrl) as the next step. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

fromChainId.description: Chain id (1, 8453, 42161, 10, 137, 56, 43114, 59144, 534352, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron) or name (eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, solana, bitcoin, tron).
